title: SCI-FI DATA | Affordable Data Bundles in Ghana
description: SCI-FI DATA (scifidata.store) sells MTN, Telecel and AirtelTigo data bundles and WAEC results checkers in Ghana. Pay with Mobile Money or card.

founder.name: Babor S. Abubakari
founder.title: Founder & CEO
founder.about: Babor S.A is the founder and CEO of SCI-FI DATA, a Ghanaian digital platform established with a vision of making internet access more affordable and accessible. With a passion for technology, innovation and entrepreneurship, he believes digital connectivity should not be a luxury but an accessible part of everyday life. Through SCI-FI DATA, he aims to simplify how people purchase mobile data bundles by providing affordable options, convenient services and a customer-focused experience. His vision extends beyond selling data bundles. He aspires to build a technology-driven brand that contributes to Ghana's growing digital economy and makes connectivity easier for individuals and businesses. His philosophy: Technology should make life easier, opportunities more accessible and the future more connected.
